decoder: TernausNet-style U-Net decoder, transposed-conv upsampling, base_filters 32, depth 4
input_preprocessing: in-graph: x * 255.0 -> tf.repeat to 3 channels -> RGB->BGR ([..., ::-1]) -> subtract Caffe channel means (103.939, 116.779, 123.68)
store_intensity_range: [0,1] float16 in the tensor store; scaling happens in-graph
train_store: merged (one row per mammogram, union of lesion masks)
mask_merging: merged per mammogram (union of lesion masks), run 3 onward
aug_mask_handling: image and mask concatenated on the channel axis, one transform, mask re-thresholded at > 0.5 after rotation
schedule_formula: warm = peak*(step+1)/max(1,warmup_steps); prog = clip((step-warmup_steps)/max(1,total_steps-warmup_steps),0,1); cos = floor + 0.5*(peak-floor)*(1+cos(pi*prog)); lr = warm if step < warmup_steps else cos
two_rate: encoder and decoder on separate optimisers of the same schedule shape
seed_handling: config.set_seeds(seed): tf.random.set_seed + np.random.seed; the patch plan is a pure function of (seed + epoch)
